module: Vue wizard for configuring LightRunner mode (port of the old Angular lightrunner module). Same structure as quickraceWizard, oneshotRaceCore.lua backend, configurator lightrunner_lightrunnerConfigurator. Children: level (> middle, title "ui.quickrace.quickraceTracks"), vehicle.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.
The title of level reuses the key "ui.busRoute.levelSelect" to avoid a new localization entry (code comment).

Root.desc: {screenId = "lightrunnerWizard", title = "ui.playmodes.lightRunner", onEnter = "lightrunner_lightrunnerConfigurator.onWizardRouteEnter", Vue only, bars hidden}

Children.desc: level (onWizardLevelRouteEnter; minor sub-route middle -> onWizardMiddleRouteEnter), vehicle (onWizardVehicleRouteEnter); grid selector scopeTree.

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
